ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly low-intensity (dark) pixel distribution across >90% of the visible surface, with high-intensity (white/beige) peaks localized exclusively to peripheral barnacle clusters and minor scarring.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniformly dark pigmentation across both lobes with minimal macro-level mottling; one distinct high-contrast focal cluster is located in the upper-medial region of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute, deep V-shaped depression with a sharp vertex and an approximate internal angle of 45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serrations present along the entire trailing edge; right lobe exhibits more jagged, saw-tooth peaks compared to the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced concave curvature along the trailing edges tapering to sharp, upward-pointing distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive clusters of high-contrast, ovoid pixel groups (barnacle colonization) localized along the leading edges and tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several vertical, high-contrast linear streaks (rake marks) are visible on the medial portion of the right lobe, oriented perpendicular to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy barnacle encrustation along the distal margins of both lobes and vertical rake marks on the right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly irregular, jagged protrusion on the trailing edge of the right lobe immediately adjacent to the median notch.
